notes.title: Update! German Localization issues
notes.notes:
As some of you might now, we have recently implemented the German localization for Busty Biz. 

Please note that that team has encountered a bug preventing users from using the German localization feature. post beta release. 

We're working hard to resolve this issue as we speak, and we’ll update everyone as soon as a fix is implemented.

If you have any questions, please contact us via our ticketing system: Busty Biz 

We apologize for the inconvenience.

The Busty Biz team

notes.notes: Fixed game stuck while loading.

notes.title: Patch Notes 1.4.276
notes.notes:
- The reworked Girl Clicker Boost is here!
- Tower events now give out additional rewards for reaching certain goals.
- Fixed a bug where in some rare cases towers didn't have enough currency to start the first floor.
- Prepared several events for the upcoming weeks.

notes.title: Update Notes 2021-02-02
notes.notes:
The game has been updated to bring you the latest updates and changes:

- All unclaimed rewards from past events are now automatically claimed on login. 

- Added more details to see which Style Cards were received when claiming random style card rewards. 

- Fixed a bug where progress notifications could interfere with a running Girl Click Boost or clicker event.

- Fixed a bug where the chat energy refill timer didn't account the already passed time.

- Fixed a bug where Rose didn't show up in the collection UI.

- Fixed a bug where the game crashed on a progress notification from a newly unlocked girl.

- Fixed a bug where changing the style of workers could crash the game.

- Prepared several events for the upcoming weeks.

- Several smaller optimizations and bug fixes.

- Sneak peek: A new event type is in the works to bring more dynamic to the overall event system.
